title: Canonical-model ordinary exceptional comparison
statement: For a family R, there exists a family of ForgetModels model such that for every X,Y,f₀,S,c under the stated separated, locally finite type and quasi-compact hypotheses, there is a natural isomorphism nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅ (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.

proof.text: Choose the native compactification and compose the normalized native open/proper forgetting comparison with the inverse scalar-normalized compact-support realization. Transport through closure and coefficient presentations to obtain one canonical family of ForgetModels and its comparison for every specified coefficient system and compactification.

proof_origin.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence; canonical-model comparison component.

from.place: Strict canonical-model substep of the ordinary exceptional comparison.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence; canonical-model comparison component.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_ordinary_counit_model_comparison (R : Family l D) :
    ∃ model : ∀ T : Space D, ForgetModel D l R T,
      ∀ (X Y : Space D) (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
        [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
        (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀)
        (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)),
      Nonempty (nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ (model Y).functor ≅
        (model X).functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F)
